_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: relapse hazard 0.10 a year x 0.7 if treated; death hazard 0.06 a year

agreement.claim: both engines report the same cause-specific log hazard ratio, standard error and interval
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: about 1e-7. harness/survival_examples.test.py maximizes the partial likelihood from scratch and shows the composite-event model estimates a different quantity. Times carry seven decimals so no event times tie.

recovery.claim: the cause-specific log hazard ratio is close to the fixture's

calibration.limits: At 800 people the miss (0.35) equalled the effect (0.36); the fixture uses 2500.
